profile.ja: 五車学園の学生対魔忍。五車で営まれているサウナが売りの銭湯『寄辺湯』の娘で、七人兄弟の末っ子。兄姉に可愛がられて天真爛漫に育った無邪気な性格と、少年っぽい童顔も相まって下級生と間違われる事もあるが、火遁使いならではの情熱と苛烈さも持ち合わせる。生まれつき片腕がなく、家族はそんな彼女を大切にし、ゆくゆくは一般人として五車の外に嫁いでもいいのではと考えていたが、本人は優しくしてくれた家族や五車のために対魔忍として活躍したいと、サイボーグアームを取り付けて鍛錬に励んだ。その努力もあってか、現在では兄弟の中で一番の忍術の使い手と目されており、前線での戦闘経験も既に豊富である。任務で出向した際には現地の銭湯やスパを巡るのが実益を兼ねた趣味で、混浴温泉にも物怖じせずに飛び込み、温水プールも一種の大浴場だと積極的に入りに行く。そのため任務時には常に水着を持ち込み、時には対魔忍スーツの下にも着込んでいることも。寄辺家は古くからの火遁家系で多くの有能な対魔忍を輩出してきたが、忍術の特性から戦での負傷が多く、家の断絶の危機に何度も見舞われた。それを案じたかつての当主が傷と疲労を緩和し、気性と逸りを鎮めるために作った蒸し風呂が『寄辺湯』の発祥で、寄辺家の若者は皆、鍛錬を兼ねてボイラー当番を交代で担当するのが習わし。家伝の忍術『劫身炎（ごうしんえん）』は自らの肉体（服や義肢を含む）を炎そのものと化して攻防に用いるという荒業で、非常に強力だが暴走すると全身どころかその魂まで燃えてしまい、意思なく炎を撒き散らす災厄となる。こうなると消火する他に手はないが、術者は体も残さず消滅してしまう。
profile.en: [INTRO] She is a student Taimanin at Gosha Academy. She is the daughter of the sauna-specialty public bath "Yoribe-yu" run by Gosha, and the youngest of seven siblings. Loved by her older brothers and sisters, she grew up innocent and carefree, and her boyish face sometimes leads others to mistake her for a lower-year student, but she also possesses the passion and intensity unique to a fire-style user. Born without one arm, her family cherished her and once thought she might someday marry outside Gosha, but she chose to serve as a Taimanin for the sake of her kind family and Gosha, installing a cybernetic arm and training hard. Thanks to her effort, she is now regarded as the best ninja-technique user among her siblings and already has abundant frontline combat experience. When dispatched on missions, she enjoys touring local baths and spas, diving into mixed-gender hot springs without hesitation, and treating heated pools as a kind of large bath, so she always brings a swimsuit on duty and sometimes wears it under her Taimanin suit. The Yoribe family has long been a fire-style lineage that has produced many capable Taimanin, but the nature of their ninjutsu often leads to injuries in battle, threatening the family line several times. Concerned, a former head of the house created a steam bath—the origin of "Yoribe-yu"—to ease wounds and fatigue and calm temperament. All young Yoribe members take turns on boiler duty as training, and the hereditary technique "Goushin-en" turns the user's entire body (including clothing and prosthetic) into flame for offense and defense; it is extremely powerful but can run amok, burning the user's body and soul, leaving only extinction as a cure.

text.ja: 火遁使いの寄辺都留だよ。五車にある寄辺湯は私の実家なんだ、サウナが売りの銭湯なんだけど任務の後に是非どうぞ！
text.en: [VOICE/Acquired] I'm Tsutome Yoribe, a fire-style user. Yoribe-yu, the sauna-famous bath in Gosha, is my family's place—feel free to drop by after a mission!

text.ja: ああ、これ？　見ての通りサイボーグアームなんだ。生まれたときからこっちの腕がなくてさ。でも不自由はないよ
text.en: [VOICE/Home] Ah, this? As you can see, it's my cybernetic arm. I was born without this arm, but it doesn't hold me back at all.

text.ja: よく下級生と間違われるけど、私はキミより先輩だよ！　たくさんいる兄姉の中で一番の忍術使いってちょっと有名なんだ！
text.en: [VOICE/Home] People often mistake me for a lower-year, but I'm senior to you! I'm even a bit famous as the top ninja-technique user among my many siblings.

text.ja: お風呂が大好きで趣味なんだ。任務で地方へ行くときもマイ水着は手放せないよね。混浴とか温水プールにも入りたいから！
text.en: [VOICE/Home] I love baths—they're my hobby. Even when I travel for missions, I never part with my swimsuit. I want to jump into mixed-gender baths and heated pools!

text.ja: 寄辺湯ではボイラー室の火力当番を交代で担当するのが寄辺の家の習わしでね～、鍛錬代わりに術の制御とかを覚えるんだよ
text.en: [VOICE/Home] At Yoribe-yu it's tradition for our family to rotate boiler-duty, which doubles as training for controlling our techniques.

text.ja: 私の火力を甘く見てるんだね。それじゃ、火傷じゃすまないってこと、後悔しながら燃え尽きてもらおうかな！　なんちゃって♪
text.en: [VOICE/Home] You're underestimating my firepower. That means a burn won't be enough—you'll regret it and burn out completely! Just kidding ♪

text.ja: お風呂はいいよね～、今度の休暇も温泉旅しよっかな。コーヒー色の温泉があるって話だから入ってみたいんだよね！
text.en: [VOICE/Home] Baths are wonderful, aren't they? I'm thinking of a hot-spring getaway for the next break. I heard there's a coffee-colored onsen—I want to try it!

text.ja: うちの蒸し風呂は疲労を緩和したり傷を癒したり、気性と気のはやりを鎮める効果があるんだ、ぜひ試してみてね
text.en: [VOICE/Home] Our steam bath eases fatigue, heals wounds, and calms temperament. You should definitely give it a try.

text.ja: 私、実のお兄ちゃんともエッチしたくなっちゃうくらい、淫らなことが好きなんだぁ。君ともねちねちと絡め合いたいな～
text.en: [VOICE/Home] I'm the type who gets turned on by even my own older brother… I'd love to get all tangled up with you, too.

text.en: [VOICE/Home] Just sucking a cock makes my throat feel amazing! My body's heating up so much steam's coming out, and my pussy's soaking wet!
